install.title: Install PageTime
install.description: For desktop Chrome and Edge. Install from the extension ZIP package.
install.getDescription: Download the pagetime extension ZIP from GitHub Releases and unzip it into a permanent folder.
install.release: Get the extension package on GitHub
install.openDescription: Enter the address for Chrome or Edge in your browser’s address bar, then turn on Developer mode.
install.loadDescription: Choose “Load unpacked” and select the folder you unzipped. Pin PageTime to the toolbar and start browsing to begin recording.

details.title: A clearer picture of your time.
details.description: Start with the big picture, then follow a day or a site into the details that matter to you.
details.rankingDescription: Active time and visit counts tell different stories. Compare their rankings, then open a site to explore its activity.
details.rankingAlt: Example active-time and visit-count rankings, with relative blue bars.
details.rankingCaption: Same sites, two useful ways to look at them.

points.range: Today, the last 7 or 30 days, or your own date range.
points.site: Filter the overview to a site and look at it in context.
points.visits: Open visit history to review when you stopped by.

popup.title: A glance from the toolbar
popup.description: See this site’s active time today, your total and today’s top sites without opening the dashboard.

scope.title: Choose what gets recorded
scope.description: Ignore selected sites, or only record a chosen list. Change the current site’s rule from the popup.

pause.title: A pause whenever you need it
pause.description: Pause and resume recording from the toolbar. Audio counting and idle preferences are in Settings.

export.title: Your records, ready to take along
export.description: Save a JSON backup or date-and-site CSV. Restore a checked JSON backup inside the extension.

setup.title: Install once. Start with your next page.
setup.update: When updating a manually loaded version, replace the files in the same folder and reload the extension to keep its identity and local records.

faq.title: A few common questions.
faq.description: A little context before you start recording.

browsers.question: Which browsers are supported?
browsers.answer: PageTime supports desktop Chrome and Edge. Download the release ZIP and follow the installation steps above.

privacy.question: Do I need an account or have to upload my records?
privacy.answer: No signup or login is needed. Your browsing records stay in the extension on this device and are not uploaded.

history.question: Does it read page contents or record private windows?
history.answer: It records hostnames, visit times and active time. It does not save page text, full URLs or titles, and does not record incognito windows.

backup.question: Can I export and restore my records?
backup.answer: Export JSON for a complete backup, or CSV for date-and-site totals. Restore JSON inside the installed extension; confirming replaces your current ledger and settings.

empty.question: Why are there no records just after installation?
empty.answer: Recording starts after installation. PageTime does not import your old browser history. The website’s product illustrations are separate from your own records.

closing.title: Your time. A little more visible.
closing.description: Add PageTime and let your next browsing day tell its own story.
